edgelab-hub-0.1.2.tgz.chart_yaml:
apiVersion: v2
appVersion: v0.1.2
description: Edge Delta Lab hub — signed chunk origin, hub multiplex/cache, push announce
  channel, unix admin socket under /state.
keywords:
- delta
- chunks
- edge
- delivery
- lab
name: edgelab-hub
type: application
version: 0.1.2
edgelab-hub-0.1.2.tgz.values_yaml:
# Default values for the edgelab-hub chart.
image:
  repository: edge-delta-lab
  tag: local
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Where the hub state lives: admin socket + durable event log (VOLUME /state).
state:
  size: 1Gi
  storageClass: ""

# The origin is mounted read-only; the hub never writes published bytes.
origin:
  size: 5Gi
  storageClass: ""
  # A real deployment populates the origin by running the publisher
  # (`edgelab publish` / watch-registry) against this PVC or by syncing
  # release objects into it. The chart mounts it read-only.

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080

admin:
  # Unix socket path UNDER /state (the state volume). Not network-exposed;
  # operators reach it with kubectl exec + edgelab-tui --admin <path>.
  socketPath: /state/admin.sock
  eventLogPath: /state/events.jsonl
  eventLogMib: 8

notifiers:
  # Credential values are read from a Secret, never from values directly.
  # Create the secret first (see templates/NOTES.txt).
  telegramTokenEnv: EDGELAB_TELEGRAM_TOKEN
  telegramChatEnv: EDGELAB_TELEGRAM_CHAT
  slackWebhookEnv: EDGELAB_SLACK_WEBHOOK
  existingSecret: edgelab-notifiers

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi

hub:
  events: true      # expose /events websocket announce channel
  cacheMib: 128     # hub object cache budget
  rateKbit: 0       # 0 = unlimited

exporter:
  enabled: false
  image:
    repository: edge-delta-lab
    tag: local
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  port: 9108
  instance: edgelab-hub

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}
podSecurityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  # Numeric UID of the daemon image's edgelab user: kubelet cannot verify a name.
  runAsUser: 100
securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  capabilities:
    drop: ["ALL"]
